```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 32: PUBLICATION-STYLE LANDSAT SCENARIO MAPS
# =========================================================

library(reticulate)
library(ggplot2)
library(png)
library(grid)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Earth Engine session and output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ee <- reticulate::import("ee", convert = FALSE)
ee$Initialize(project = "thinking-leaf-305215")

plot_dir <- "Tharaka_Landsat_Enhanced_Maps"

dir.create(
  plot_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Seasonal labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

scenario_labels <- c(
  dry_feb = "February Dry Season (10–20 February)",
  dry_sep = "September Dry Season (15–25 September)",
  wet_may = "May Wet Season (5–30 May)",
  wet_dec = "December Wet Season (5–30 December)"
)

scenario_names <- names(selected_composites)

if (length(scenario_names) != 16) {
  stop("Expected 16 scenarios; found ",
       length(scenario_names), ".")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Processing log
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot_results <- data.frame(
  composite = scenario_names,
  status = "Pending",
  file = NA_character_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Generate enhanced maps
# ---------------------------------------------------------

for (i in seq_along(scenario_names)) {

  scenario <- scenario_names[i]

  message(
    "\nProcessing ", i, " of ",
    length(scenario_names), ": ", scenario
  )

  temp_png <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

  tryCatch({

    img <- selected_composites[[scenario]]

    year <- sub("_.*$", "", scenario)
    window <- sub("^\\d{4}_", "", scenario)

    if (!window %in% names(scenario_labels)) {
      stop("Unknown seasonal window: ", window)
    }

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # A. True-colour RGB visualisation
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    rgb_img <- ee$Image$visualize(
      img,
      bands = c("red", "green", "blue"),
      min = 0.02,
      max = 0.30,
      gamma = 1.3
    )

   # -----------------------------------------------------
# B. Add ONLY the ROI boundary, keeping the image visible
# -----------------------------------------------------

roi_fc <- ee$FeatureCollection(
  ee$Feature(roi)
)

# Paint the boundary into a blank image
boundary_img <- ee$Image$constant(0)$byte()$paint(
  roi_fc, 1, 2
)

# Mask out all pixels except the painted boundary
boundary_masked <- boundary_img$updateMask(
  boundary_img
)

# Visualise the boundary in white
boundary_vis <- boundary_masked$visualize(
  palette = c("FFFFFF"),
  min = 0,
  max = 1,
  opacity = 1
)

# Overlay the boundary without covering the RGB imagery
map_img <- rgb_img$blend(boundary_vis)

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # C. Download thumbnail
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    thumb <- map_img$getThumbURL(
      reticulate::dict(
        region = roi,
        dimensions = 1200,
        format = "png"
      )
    )

    thumb_url <- reticulate::py_to_r(thumb)

    download.file(
      url = thumb_url,
      destfile = temp_png,
      mode = "wb",
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    raster_img <- png::readPNG(temp_png)

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # D. Create framed map
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    p <- ggplot() +

      annotation_raster(
        raster_img,
        xmin = 0, xmax = 1,
        ymin = 0, ymax = 1
      ) +

      # North arrow
      annotate(
        "segment",
        x = 0.93, xend = 0.93,
        y = 0.77, yend = 0.89,
        linewidth = 0.8,
        colour = "black",
        arrow = grid::arrow(
          length = grid::unit(0.16, "cm"),
          type = "closed"
        )
      ) +

      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0.93, y = 0.93,
        label = "N",
        fontface = "bold",
        size = 4
      ) +

      # RGB key
      annotate(
        "label",
        x = 0.03, y = 0.97,
        label = "RGB KEY\nR: Red\nG: Green\nB: Blue",
        hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
        size = 3,
        label.size = 0.3,
        fill = "white",
        alpha = 0.92
      ) +

      coord_fixed(
        xlim = c(0, 1),
        ylim = c(0, 1),
        expand = FALSE
      ) +

      labs(
        title = paste(
          "THARAKA SUB-COUNTY —", year
        ),
        subtitle = paste(
          scenario_labels[[window]],
          "| Landsat Collection 2 Level-2"
        ),
        caption = paste(
          "True-colour RGB composite | Nominal pixel size: 30 m",
          "\nWhite line: study-area boundary | RGB stretch for display"
        )
      ) +

      theme_void(base_size = 12) +

      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = 16,
          hjust = 0.5,
          margin = margin(b = 8)
        ),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(
          size = 10,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        plot.caption = element_text(
          size = 8,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        panel.border = element_rect(
          colour = "black",
          fill = NA,
          linewidth = 1
        ),
        plot.background = element_rect(
          fill = "white",
          colour = NA
        ),
        plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
      )

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # E. Save high-resolution PNG
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    output_file <- file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0("Tharaka_", scenario, ".png")
    )

    ggsave(
      filename = output_file,
      plot = p,
      width = 9,
      height = 7,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 300,
      bg = "white"
    )

    plot_results$status[i] <- "Success"
    plot_results$file[i] <- output_file

    message("Saved: ", output_file)

  }, error = function(e) {

    plot_results$status[i] <<- paste(
      "Failed:", conditionMessage(e)
    )

    message(
      "Error for ", scenario, ": ",
      conditionMessage(e)
    )

  }, finally = {

    if (file.exists(temp_png)) {
      unlink(temp_png)
    }

  })
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save processing log and report
# ---------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  plot_results,
  file.path(plot_dir, "Scenario_Plot_Processing_Log.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("ENHANCED MAP EXPORT COMPLETE\n")
cat("Successful:", sum(plot_results$status == "Success"), "\n")
cat("Failed:", sum(plot_results$status != "Success"), "\n")
cat("Output folder:", normalizePath(plot_dir), "\n")
cat("====================================\n")

print(plot_results)
```

```{r section-33-study-area-location-map, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 33: STUDY-AREA LOCATION MAP
# Kenya -> Tharaka-Nithi County -> Tharaka study area
# =========================================================

library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(geodata)
library(patchwork)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create output directories
# ---------------------------------------------------------

locator_dir <- "Tharaka_Land_Cover_Results"

boundary_dir <- file.path(
  locator_dir,
  "Administrative_Boundaries"
)

plot_dir <- "Tharaka_Landsat_Enhanced_Maps"

dir.create(
  boundary_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  plot_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load Kenya administrative boundaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------

message("Loading Kenya administrative boundaries...")

kenya_counties <- sf::st_as_sf(
  geodata::gadm(
    country = "KEN",
    level = 1,
    path = boundary_dir
  )
)

kenya_country <- sf::st_as_sf(
  geodata::gadm(
    country = "KEN",
    level = 0,
    path = boundary_dir
  )
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(kenya_counties) > 0,
  "NAME_1" %in% names(kenya_counties)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Select Tharaka-Nithi County
# ---------------------------------------------------------

county <- kenya_counties[
  grepl(
    "tharaka",
    kenya_counties$NAME_1,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  ) &
    grepl(
      "nithi",
      kenya_counties$NAME_1,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ),
]

if (nrow(county) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Expected exactly one Tharaka-Nithi County feature; found ",
    nrow(county),
    ". Check unique(kenya_counties$NAME_1)."
  )
}

message("Selected county: ", county$NAME_1)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Recover the Tharaka study-area boundary
#
# Prefer the existing study_area_sf or study_area object.
# If neither is available, reconstruct it from GADM level 2.
# No Earth Engine query is needed for this location map.
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if (exists("study_area_sf", inherits = TRUE)) {

  roi_sf <- get("study_area_sf", inherits = TRUE)

  if (!inherits(roi_sf, "sf")) {
    roi_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(roi_sf)
  }

} else if (exists("study_area", inherits = TRUE)) {

  roi_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
    get("study_area", inherits = TRUE)
  )

} else {

  message("Recovering Tharaka boundary from GADM level 2...")

  kenya_adm2 <- sf::st_as_sf(
    geodata::gadm(
      country = "KEN",
      level = 2,
      path = boundary_dir
    )
  )

  roi_sf <- kenya_adm2[
    kenya_adm2$NAME_2 == "Tharaka" &
      kenya_adm2$NAME_1 == "Tharaka-Nithi",
  ]

  if (nrow(roi_sf) != 1) {
    stop(
      "Could not identify exactly one Tharaka study-area polygon."
    )
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Standardize and validate geometries
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kenya_counties <- sf::st_transform(
  kenya_counties, 4326
)

kenya_country <- sf::st_transform(
  kenya_country, 4326
)

county <- sf::st_transform(
  county, 4326
)

roi_sf <- sf::st_transform(
  roi_sf, 4326
)

roi_sf <- sf::st_make_valid(roi_sf)

if (nrow(roi_sf) == 0 ||
    any(sf::st_is_empty(roi_sf))) {
  stop("The Tharaka study-area geometry is empty.")
}

# Retain only polygon components if validity repair
# has produced a geometry collection.
geometry_types <- as.character(
  sf::st_geometry_type(roi_sf)
)

if (any(geometry_types == "GEOMETRY")) {
  roi_sf <- sf::st_collection_extract(
    roi_sf,
    "POLYGON",
    warn = FALSE
  )
}

if (nrow(roi_sf) == 0 ||
    !all(sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf))) {
  stop("The study-area boundary is not a valid polygon.")
}

message("Study-area geometry validated successfully.")

# Confirm the study area intersects the intended county.
overlap <- sf::st_intersects(
  roi_sf,
  county,
  sparse = FALSE
)

if (!all(overlap)) {
  stop(
    "The study-area boundary does not intersect ",
    "Tharaka-Nithi County. Check the selected boundaries."
  )
}

# Calculate percentage of the study area inside the county.
roi_area <- sf::st_transform(roi_sf, 6933)
county_area <- sf::st_transform(county, 6933)

inside_area <- sf::st_intersection(
  roi_area,
  county_area
)

overlap_pct <- 100 * as.numeric(
  sum(sf::st_area(inside_area)) /
    sum(sf::st_area(roi_area))
)

cat(
  "Percentage of study area inside Tharaka-Nithi County:",
  round(overlap_pct, 2), "%\n"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Map 1: Kenya, with county boundaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_kenya <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = kenya_country,
    fill = "#F7F7F7",
    colour = "#444444",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = kenya_counties,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "#B7B7B7",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = county,
    fill = "#E76F51",
    colour = "#8C2D04",
    linewidth = 0.65
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "KENYA",
    subtitle = "Tharaka-Nithi County highlighted"
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5, size = 9
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Map 2: Tharaka-Nithi County and study area
# ---------------------------------------------------------

county_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(county)

county_x <- c(
  unname(county_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.12,
  unname(county_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.12
)

county_y <- c(
  unname(county_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.08,
  unname(county_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.08
)

p_county <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = county,
    fill = "#E9E9E9",
    colour = "#333333",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = roi_sf,
    fill = "#65A765",
    colour = "#185C37",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "THARAKA-NITHI COUNTY",
    subtitle = "Tharaka study area highlighted"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = county_x,
    ylim = county_y,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5, size = 9
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Map 3: Detailed Tharaka study-area boundary
# ---------------------------------------------------------

roi_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(roi_sf)

roi_x <- c(
  unname(roi_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.025,
  unname(roi_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.025
)

roi_y <- c(
  unname(roi_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.025,
  unname(roi_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.025
)

p_detail <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = roi_sf,
    fill = "#A8D5BA",
    colour = "#185C37",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "THARAKA STUDY AREA",
    subtitle = "Boundary used in the Landsat analysis"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = roi_x,
    ylim = roi_y,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5, size = 9
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Combine the three maps
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_locator_0 <- (p_kenya | p_county | p_detail) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1.1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Location of the Tharaka Study Area, Kenya",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Geographic context for the 2000, 2010, 2020 and 2025",
      "seasonal Landsat analysis"
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Administrative boundaries: GADM.",
      "Study boundary: Tharaka Sub-county."
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 17, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 11, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 8, hjust = 0
      )
    )
  )

print(p_locator_0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Export the location map
# ---------------------------------------------------------

png_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "Tharaka_Study_Area_Location_Map.png"
)

pdf_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "Tharaka_Study_Area_Location_Map.pdf"
)

ggsave(
  filename = png_file,
  plot = p_locator_0,
  width = 15,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = pdf_file,
  plot = p_locator_0,
  width = 15,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

cat(
  "\nSECTION 33 COMPLETED\n",
  "County: ", county$NAME_1, "\n",
  "Study-area overlap: ", round(overlap_pct, 2), "%\n",
  "PNG: ", normalizePath(png_file, winslash = "/"), "\n",
  "PDF: ", normalizePath(pdf_file, winslash = "/"), "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# FIX: VALIDATE AND REPAIR STUDY-AREA GEOMETRY
# =========================================================

# Check the current geometry
print(sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf, reason = TRUE))

# Repair invalid geometry
roi_sf <- sf::st_make_valid(roi_sf)

# Keep polygonal components only
roi_sf <- sf::st_collection_extract(
  roi_sf,
  "POLYGON",
  warn = FALSE
)

# Confirm validity
print(sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf))

# Stop only if the geometry remains invalid
if (!all(sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf))) {
  stop("The study-area geometry is still invalid. Inspect the geometry.")
}

cat("Study-area geometry validated successfully.\n")
```



```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 33A: CHECK STUDY-AREA LOCATION
# =========================================================

# Check whether the ROI intersects Tharaka-Nithi County
overlap <- sf::st_intersects(
  roi_sf,
  county,
  sparse = FALSE
)

print(overlap)

if (all(overlap)) {
  cat("The study area intersects Tharaka-Nithi County.\n")
} else {
  warning(
    "The study area does not intersect Tharaka-Nithi County. ",
    "Check the ROI and coordinate reference system."
  )
}

# Estimate how much of the ROI lies inside the county
roi_area <- sf::st_transform(roi_sf, 6933)
county_area <- sf::st_transform(county, 6933)

inside_area <- sf::st_intersection(
  roi_area,
  county_area
)

overlap_pct <- 100 * sum(sf::st_area(inside_area)) /
  sum(sf::st_area(roi_area))

cat(
  "Percentage of study area inside Tharaka-Nithi County:",
  round(as.numeric(overlap_pct), 2), "%\n"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 33: STUDY-AREA LOCATION MAP
# Kenya -> Tharaka-Nithi County -> Tharaka study area
# =========================================================

library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(geodata)
library(reticulate)
library(jsonlite)
library(geojsonsf)
library(patchwork)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Output folder
# ---------------------------------------------------------

locator_dir <- "Tharaka_Land_Cover_Results"
dir.create(locator_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

boundary_dir <- file.path(locator_dir, "Administrative_Boundaries")
dir.create(boundary_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Download GADM administrative boundaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kenya_counties <- sf::st_as_sf(
  geodata::gadm(
    country = "KEN",
    level = 1,
    path = boundary_dir
  )
)

kenya_country <- sf::st_as_sf(
  geodata::gadm(
    country = "KEN",
    level = 0,
    path = boundary_dir
  )
)

# Inspect county names if necessary
print(sort(unique(kenya_counties$NAME_1)))

# Select Tharaka-Nithi County robustly
county <- kenya_counties[
  grepl(
    "tharaka",
    kenya_counties$NAME_1,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  ) &
  grepl(
    "nithi",
    kenya_counties$NAME_1,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  ),
]

if (nrow(county) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Expected one Tharaka-Nithi County feature, found ",
    nrow(county),
    ". Check kenya_counties$NAME_1."
  )
}

cat("Selected county:", county$NAME_1, "\n")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Convert Earth Engine ROI to sf and repair its geometry
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ee <- reticulate::import("ee", convert = FALSE)

# Extract the ROI already used in the Landsat analysis
roi_info <- reticulate::py_to_r(
  ee$Feature(roi)$getInfo()
)

roi_feature <- list(
  type = "Feature",
  properties = list(name = "Tharaka study area"),
  geometry = roi_info$geometry
)

roi_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  roi_feature,
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  null = "null"
)

roi_sf <- geojsonsf::geojson_sf(roi_json)

# Set coordinate reference systems consistently
county <- sf::st_transform(county, 4326)
kenya_counties <- sf::st_transform(kenya_counties, 4326)
kenya_country <- sf::st_transform(kenya_country, 4326)
roi_sf <- sf::st_transform(roi_sf, 4326)

# Repair the geometry AFTER recreating roi_sf
cat("Original geometry validity:\n")
print(sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf, reason = TRUE))

roi_sf <- sf::st_make_valid(roi_sf)

# Keep polygonal geometry; if already polygonal, no extraction is needed
if (!all(sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf))) {
  roi_sf <- sf::st_collection_extract(
    roi_sf, "POLYGON", warn = FALSE
  )
}

# Confirm the final geometry
valid_roi <- sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf)

if (!all(valid_roi)) {
  stop("ROI geometry remains invalid after repair.")
}

if (nrow(roi_sf) == 0) {
  stop("No valid polygon remains in roi_sf.")
}

cat("Study-area geometry validated successfully.\n")

# Verify the study area still overlaps the intended county
overlap <- sf::st_intersects(
  roi_sf, county, sparse = FALSE
)

if (!all(overlap)) {
  warning("The ROI does not intersect Tharaka-Nithi County.")
}

# Calculate percentage of ROI inside the county
roi_area <- sf::st_transform(roi_sf, 6933)
county_area <- sf::st_transform(county, 6933)

inside_area <- sf::st_intersection(
  roi_area, county_area
)

overlap_pct <- 100 *
  sum(sf::st_area(inside_area)) /
  sum(sf::st_area(roi_area))

cat(
  "Percentage of study area inside Tharaka-Nithi County:",
  round(as.numeric(overlap_pct), 2), "%\n"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create map 1: Kenya with county highlighted
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_kenya <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = kenya_country,
    fill = "#F7F7F7",
    colour = "#444444",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = kenya_counties,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "#B7B7B7",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = county,
    fill = "#E76F51",
    colour = "#8C2D04",
    linewidth = 0.65
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "KENYA",
    subtitle = "Tharaka-Nithi County highlighted"
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create map 2: County with study area highlighted
# ---------------------------------------------------------

county_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(county)

county_x <- c(
  unname(county_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.12,
  unname(county_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.12
)

county_y <- c(
  unname(county_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.08,
  unname(county_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.08
)

p_county <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = county,
    fill = "#E9E9E9",
    colour = "#333333",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = roi_sf,
    fill = "#65A765",
    colour = "#185C37",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "THARAKA-NITHI COUNTY",
    subtitle = "Tharaka study area highlighted"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = county_x,
    ylim = county_y,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Create map 3: Detailed study-area boundary
# ---------------------------------------------------------

roi_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(roi_sf)

roi_x <- c(
  unname(roi_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.025,
  unname(roi_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.025
)

roi_y <- c(
  unname(roi_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.025,
  unname(roi_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.025
)

p_detail <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = roi_sf,
    fill = "#A8D5BA",
    colour = "#185C37",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "THARAKA STUDY AREA",
    subtitle = "Boundary used in the Landsat analysis"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = roi_x,
    ylim = roi_y,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Combine the three maps
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_locator_0 <- (p_kenya | p_county | p_detail) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1.1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Location of the Tharaka Study Area, Kenya",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Geographic context for the 2000, 2010, 2020 and 2025",
      "seasonal Landsat analysis"
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Administrative boundaries: GADM.",
      "Study boundary: ROI used in the Earth Engine analysis."
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 17, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 11, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
    )
  )

print(p_locator_0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Export publication-quality files
# ---------------------------------------------------------


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# SAVE LOCATOR MAP IN THE EXISTING MAP DIRECTORY
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot_dir <- "Tharaka_Landsat_Enhanced_Maps"

dir.create(
  plot_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# Save high-resolution PNG
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "Tharaka_Study_Area_Location_Map.png"
  ),
  plot = p_locator_0,
  width = 15,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# Save publication-quality PDF
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "Tharaka_Study_Area_Location_Map.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_locator_0,
  width = 15,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

# Display the map
print(p_locator_0)

cat(
  "\nLocator maps saved successfully in:\n",
  normalizePath(plot_dir),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

)

county_y <- c(

)

p_county <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = county,

  ) +

  ) +

    name = "Map key",

  ) +
  labs(
    title = "THARAKA-NITHI COUNTY",
    subtitle = "Study boundary highlighted"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = county_x,
    ylim = county_y,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(

    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 9, hjust = 0.5
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.35, "cm")
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Detailed study-area view with north compass
# ---------------------------------------------------------

roi_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(roi_sf)

roi_x <- c(
  as.numeric(roi_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.025,
  as.numeric(roi_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.025
)

roi_y <- c(
  as.numeric(roi_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.025,
  as.numeric(roi_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.025
)

p_detail <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = roi_sf,
    aes(fill = "Study-area boundary"),
    colour = "#185C37",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Map key",
    values = c("Study-area boundary" = "#A8D5BA")
  ) +
  # North arrow / compass
  ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(

    style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering
  ) +

  ) +

    xlim = roi_x,
    ylim = roi_y,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

    ),

    ),

  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_locator <- (p_kenya | p_county | p_detail) +

  plot_annotation(
    title = "Location of the Tharaka Study Area, Kenya",

    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 8, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save high-resolution outputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------

locator_dir <- "Tharaka_Land_Cover_Results"
dir.create(locator_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  file.path(locator_dir, "Tharaka_Study_Area_Location_Map.png"),

  width = 15,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(

  width = 15,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

print(p_locator)

cat("Locator map saved as PNG and PDF.\n")
```
